title: 請假與排班
description: 請假、排班與休假相關用語

sentences.en: I would like to request a day off next Friday, as I have a medical appointment that cannot be rescheduled.
sentences.zh: 我想請下週五的假，因為我有一個無法改期的醫療預約。

sentences.en: Could you please check whether my leave request, which I submitted last Monday, has been approved by the manager?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我確認一下我上週一提交的請假申請是否已經被經理批准了嗎？

sentences.en: Due to a family emergency that arose unexpectedly, I need to take three consecutive days off starting tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 由於突然發生的家庭緊急狀況，我需要從明天開始連續請三天假。

sentences.en: The shift schedule for next month, which was posted on the bulletin board yesterday, seems to have several conflicts.
sentences.zh: 昨天公告在佈告欄上的下個月排班表，似乎有幾個衝突的地方。

sentences.en: I was wondering if it would be possible to swap my Saturday shift with someone who is available on that day.
sentences.zh: 我想知道是否有可能跟某位那天有空的人交換我週六的班。

sentences.en: According to the company policy, which was updated recently, employees are entitled to fifteen paid vacation days per year.
sentences.zh: 根據最近更新的公司政策，員工每年享有十五天的帶薪休假。

sentences.en: Since I have already used all my personal leave days, I will need to apply for unpaid leave for the remainder.
sentences.zh: 因為我已經用完了所有的事假天數，剩餘的部分我需要申請無薪假。

sentences.en: The HR department informed me that my annual leave balance, including the days carried over from last year, totals twenty-two days.
sentences.zh: 人資部門通知我，我的年假餘額包括去年結轉的天數，總共有二十二天。

sentences.en: Would it be acceptable if I adjusted my working hours next week, arriving earlier and leaving before the usual time?
sentences.zh: 如果我調整下週的工作時間，提早到班並比平常早離開，這樣可以嗎？

sentences.en: My supervisor suggested that I take my remaining vacation days before the end of the fiscal year to avoid losing them.
sentences.zh: 我的主管建議我在會計年度結束前把剩餘的假期休完，以免作廢。

sentences.en: The new scheduling system, which was implemented to reduce conflicts, allows employees to indicate their preferred shifts online.
sentences.zh: 為了減少排班衝突而實施的新排班系統，允許員工在線上標註自己偏好的班次。

sentences.en: I need to take maternity leave starting from the first of March, and I have already prepared a handover document for my replacement.
sentences.zh: 我需要從三月一日開始休產假，我已經為接替我的人準備好了交接文件。

sentences.en: After discussing it with my team leader, who was very understanding, we agreed that I could work remotely during my recovery period.
sentences.zh: 在與非常體諒我的組長討論後，我們同意我可以在恢復期間遠端工作。

sentences.en: The overtime hours that I accumulated last month should be converted into compensatory leave, according to our labor agreement.
sentences.zh: 根據我們的勞動協議，我上個月累積的加班時數應該轉換為補休。

sentences.en: I am writing to inform you that I will be on sick leave today, as I woke up with a severe migraine and cannot concentrate.
sentences.zh: 我寫信通知您我今天要請病假，因為我起床時嚴重偏頭痛，無法集中精神。

sentences.en: Before submitting the leave application, please ensure that you have obtained written approval from your direct supervisor.
sentences.zh: 在提交請假申請之前，請確保你已經取得直屬主管的書面批准。

sentences.en: The scheduling manager, who is responsible for coordinating all departments, asked me to confirm my availability for the holiday shift.
sentences.zh: 負責協調所有部門的排班經理要求我確認我是否能上假日班。

sentences.en: Given that several team members have already requested leave during the same period, it might be difficult to approve additional requests.
sentences.zh: 鑑於已經有好幾位團隊成員申請了同一時段的休假，可能很難再批准額外的請假。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could let me know the deadline for submitting our preferred schedule for the upcoming quarter.
sentences.zh: 如果您能告訴我提交下一季偏好排班的截止日期，我會很感激。

sentences.en: The bereavement leave policy, which provides up to seven days for immediate family members, is outlined in the employee handbook.
sentences.zh: 喪假政策在員工手冊中有說明，直系親屬最多可請七天。

sentences.en: Since my colleague is also taking leave next week, we need to find someone who can cover both of our responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 由於我的同事下週也要請假，我們需要找到一個能同時負責我們兩人工作的人。

sentences.en: I have arranged for my assistant to handle all urgent matters while I am away on my two-week vacation.
sentences.zh: 我已經安排我的助理在我兩週假期不在的時候處理所有緊急事務。

sentences.en: The company recently introduced a flexible scheduling option, which allows employees to choose between morning and afternoon shifts.
sentences.zh: 公司最近推出了彈性排班選項，允許員工在早班和午班之間選擇。

sentences.en: To ensure adequate coverage during the peak season, the manager has decided to limit vacation approvals to one person per team.
sentences.zh: 為了確保旺季期間有足夠的人力，經理決定每個團隊同時只批准一人休假。

sentences.en: I forgot to submit my leave request through the online portal, so I need to ask HR whether a late submission can still be processed.
sentences.zh: 我忘了透過線上系統提交請假申請，所以我需要問人資是否還能處理遲交的申請。

sentences.en: My doctor recommended that I take at least one week of medical leave to recover fully from the surgery I had last Friday.
sentences.zh: 我的醫生建議我至少請一週的病假，以便從上週五的手術中完全康復。

sentences.en: The night shift rotation, which changes every two weeks, requires employees to adjust their sleep schedules accordingly.
sentences.zh: 每兩週輪換一次的夜班，要求員工相應地調整他們的睡眠時間表。

sentences.en: I plan to use my accumulated compensatory hours to take a half-day off this Thursday, if that works for the team.
sentences.zh: 如果團隊方便的話，我打算用我累積的補休時數在這週四請半天假。

sentences.en: Please note that any leave requests exceeding five consecutive days must be submitted at least two weeks in advance for approval.
sentences.zh: 請注意，任何超過連續五天的請假申請必須至少提前兩週提交以供審批。

sentences.en: After reviewing the shift roster, I noticed that I have been assigned to work on three consecutive weekends, which seems excessive.
sentences.zh: 在查看排班表後，我注意到我被排了連續三個週末的班，這似乎過多了。
